problem_request_method: This action is not allowed here.
problem_request_path: The address holds an invalid value.
problem_request_query: The request holds an invalid value.
problem_auth_backoff: Too many failed attempts. Please wait a moment.
problem_auth_configured: The admin password is already set.
problem_auth_password: The password does not meet the requirements.
problem_viewer_name: A viewer with this name already exists.
problem_viewer_value: A viewer needs a name of at most 64 bytes.
problem_token_value: A token needs a name of at most 64 bytes.
problem_history_range: This range is empty or too long.
problem_history_counter: A counter has no means over this range.
problem_forecast_range: This forecast range is empty or too long.
problem_role_none: This device reports no live value for this role.
problem_layout_none: No PV layout has been set up yet.
problem_layout_device: A string is wired to an unknown device.
problem_layout_input: A string names an MPPT input the device does not have.
problem_layout_string: A string id is unknown or used twice.
problem_layout_module_type: A string names an unknown module type.
problem_layout_value: A value is outside its physical range.
problem_layout_scene: A module grid names a missing roof face, or a module an unknown string or one of another module type.
problem_layout_setback: A module sits outside its roof face's setback.
problem_layout_covered: A module lies on a chimney or a roof window.
problem_topology_none: No plant topology has been set up yet.
problem_topology_tree: The measurement points do not form one tree rooted at the grid connection.
problem_topology_point: A measurement point id is unknown or used twice.
problem_topology_claim: A measurement point has no device, devices measuring different roles, or a device role claimed twice.
problem_topology_role: A measurement point names a role that is not a power role, or grid power anywhere but the root.
problem_topology_device: A measurement point names an unknown device.
problem_tariff_none: No tariff applies at that time.
problem_tariff_band: A band needs weekdays from 1 to 7 and a span of one day from HH:MM to a later HH:MM, without overlapping another band of its flow.
problem_tariff_charge: A standing charge is an amount from 0 up.
problem_tariff_past: A tariff change applies from now or later; prices already in force stay as they were.
problem_tariff_retention: Repricing reaches back only as far as stored history is kept.
problem_investment_value: An investment is an amount in EUR above zero.
problem_location_none: The plant's location has not been set yet.
problem_location_value: A latitude must lie from -90 to 90 and a longitude from -180 to 180.
problem_car_size: A car model may be at most 20 MB.
problem_car_file: The file is no glTF 2.0 binary (.glb).
problem_car_uri: The model links to files outside it; export it with every texture and buffer embedded.
problem_car_none: There is no such car model.
problem_zone_value: The plant does not know this timezone.
problem_retention_value: Keep history for at least one day.
problem_connection_value: A connection needs a name, a host and a port other than 0.
problem_connection_poll_seconds: The poll interval is 1 to 60 seconds, and only a Modbus connection has one.
problem_connection_in_use: A device still uses this connection.
problem_device_connection: The device names an unknown connection.
problem_device_transport: The device cannot be read through this connection.
problem_device_profile: The device names an unknown profile.
problem_device_profile_change: A device's profile cannot be changed; its history is stored in that profile.
problem_device_address: Another device already uses this unit id on the same endpoint.
problem_deadband_role: The device's profile does not read this role.
problem_deadband_kind: A counter or status stores every change and takes no deadband.
problem_deadband_step: A deadband cannot be below the step the role is stored in.
problem_scan_subnet: Scan a private network of at most 256 addresses, such as 192.168.1.0/24.
problem_setting_none: The device's profile declares no such setting.
problem_setting_read_only: This value is read, never written.
problem_setting_value: The value is outside the setting's range or steps.
problem_setting_writes_off: Writes are switched off for this device.
problem_setting_interval: This setting was written too recently; wait for its minimum interval.
problem_setting_precondition: The device is not in a state that allows this setting to be written.
problem_setting_community: A community profile loads read-only: its settings are not written.
problem_setting_not_enabled: This setting writes only once the admin has enabled it.
problem_setting_no_snapshot: The lock is not engaged: no value is stored to restore.
problem_secret_missing: The connection holds no secret of the name this setting's unlock needs.
problem_secret_value: The connection's secret is not a code this setting's unlock can write.
problem_index_value: A profile index needs an http or https URL.
problem_update_none: No update waits for this profile.
problem_import_path: There is no archive at that path under /share, or none was uploaded.
problem_import_size: An uploaded archive may be at most 1 GiB; put a larger one in /share.
problem_import_file: The file is no SunReye 3 export this version reads.
problem_import_device: A device mapping names a SunReye 3 device the archive lacks, or a device that does not exist.
problem_import_profile: The archive lacks the profile of a mapped SunReye 3 device.
problem_backup_name: Name the backup with a plain file name: no folder, not starting with a dot.
problem_backup_exists: A file of that name already exists in /share; a backup never overwrites one.
problem_clock_unsynced: The clock is not synchronised; history is held.
problem_storage_full: The disk is full; history is not stored, live values continue.
problem_internal: Internal error in the SunReye core.
builder_form: Describe the PV plant in the form
builder_no_module_types: Pick a roof face and add its module type there.
builder_face_hint: Tap the roof to place a module, or drag across free roof to lay a row. A drag on a module moves it, a tap selects it.
builder_string_hint: Drag across modules on the roof to wire them in that order. Tap a wired module to unwire it.
builder_refused_module_type: {name} has another module type than this grid.
builder_unassigned: {count} modules belong to no string and produce nothing.
misplaced_face: A module grid lies on a roof face that no longer exists.
misplaced_moduleType: A module grid names an unknown module type.
misplaced_chimney: Grid {grid}: module {module} lies on a chimney.
misplaced_window: Grid {grid}: module {module} lies on a roof window.
builder_cold_voltage: {name}: {voltage} V open-circuit at −10 °C exceeds the inverter's {limit} V.
settings_device_writes_hint: Off: no value is written to this device.
settings_builder: Edit the 3D house and PV modules
settings_builder_hint: Roofs, modules and strings drive the forecast.
display_low_power_hint: Nothing moves, glass turns solid, 2D instead of 3D.
display_haptics_hint: A short vibration on selection and confirmation.
display_haptics_low_power: Off while low power is on.
display_haptics_reduced: Off because the system reduces motion.
display_quality_hint: How sharply the 3D house is drawn.
display_quality_now: Auto currently draws {level} on this device.
settings_off: Not verified on hardware: written only once enabled.
settings_community: Community profile: written only once enabled.
updates_note: Each setting an update adds or changes stays off until you enable it again.
outcome_mismatch: Mismatch: the device holds another value.
outcome_unknown: Unknown: the device's state could not be read.
outcome_partial: Partially written: the device's state is uncertain.
outcome_unchanged: Unchanged: the value was already set.
devices_subnet: Network, empty for the core's own
devices_endpoint: Enter an endpoint by hand, such as an RTU gateway the scan does not probe
topology_waiting: No device has delivered readings yet.
topology_adjust_hint: Tap a point to rename, move or remove it.
layout_later: Without 3D, “Done” carries on; the layout can be drawn later in the builder.
devices_hint: SunReye searches the local network for inverters, meters and gateways. Recognised devices are chosen already.
devices_others_hint: They answer, but no profile recognises them.
devices_none_hint: If the device is on another network, name it above or enter the endpoint by hand.
password_hint: You sign in as the administrator with this password. Only the administrator changes settings.
plant_hint: SunReye cuts days in this timezone; from the location it works out the sun and the forecast.
plant_here_refused: The browser does not share the location. Enter it by hand.
topology_hint: This is how your plant measures, with its readings right now. If the tree is right, confirm it.
import_note: Export with SunReye 3's `sunreye export`, then put the file in /share or upload it. Recording carries on while it imports.
import_confirm_note: Imported history cannot be removed again.
import_done: Imported: {series} series, {points} change points, {hours} hours, {days} days.
import_unread: No v5 quantity reads these; not imported:
import_unmapped: Mapped to no device; not imported:
forecast_estimated_note: ≈ estimated: strings sharing an MPPT input are measured together and split by modelled current.
forecast_horizon: The forecast reaches two days ahead; later days stay empty.
forecast_verdict_even: {when}, {made} were produced, as much as forecast.
forecast_verdict_made: {when}, {made} were produced; no forecast covers that time.
forecast_verdict_none: This range has neither readings nor a forecast.
builder_no_location: Without the plant's location the sun stays put and no clear sky is computed.
builder_recent: last 30 days {measured} kWh measured, {modelled} kWh modelled ({deviation})
builder_no_recent: no readings against archive weather yet
range_chart_keys: {chart}. Arrow keys pick a band, Shift and arrows a span, Enter opens.
error_hint: This view could not be shown. Reload it, or go back to the dashboard.
error_missing_hint: SunReye has nothing at this address.
rd_shared_note: Estimated: input {input} measures its {count} strings together. The power is split by modelled current.
detail_live_none: No values in the last 2 minutes
heat_keys: {label}. Arrow keys pick a cell, Enter opens the column.
heat_idle_week: {name} per hour in the day's week
strings_foot: kWh for {range}. Measured vs model: the MPPT input's last 30 days. “Estimated”: strings on a shared MPPT input are measured together and split by modelled current.
strings_weak: {delta} against the model in the last 30 days. Check for shade, soiling or a faulty module.
strings_face_east: {delta} over the model in the morning, under it in the afternoon: the modules likely face further east than the PV layout says.
strings_face_west: {delta} over the model in the afternoon, under it in the morning: the modules likely face further west than the PV layout says.
strings_fresh: The correction learns from finished days, three days after the archive weather is settled. The grid fills month by month.
strings_grid_idle: Measured divided by modelled, per month and hour
strings_grid_label: Correction by month and time of day
controls_writes_off: The writes switch is off, so nothing here can change.
controls_footnote: Limits and steps come from the device profile. Every change is read back.
controls_needs_enable: Needs your enable under Settings › Writes
stats_verdict_no_money: {when}: without a tariff there are no savings to work out.
stats_verdict_autarky: {when} {share} of the house load came from the plant, {bought} from the grid.
stats_verdict_learning: Too few days to judge the strings yet: the correction has been learning since {date}.
stats_verdict_weak: {count} of {total} MPPT inputs deliver clearly less than the model expects.
stats_verdict_fine: Nothing stands out: every MPPT input is close to its model.
stats_verdict_none: Nothing was recorded in this span.
stats_error_text: The core did not answer within 10 s. Live values keep running; the range and view stay as they are.
stats_chart_energy: Production and house load over time
stats_chart_autarky: Where the house load came from, over time
stats_saved_note: without the plant less with it
stats_standing_note: owed with or without the plant
stats_autarky_note: Share of the house load the plant covered
stats_self_use_note: Share of production used in the house
stats_note_gap: {hours} h without data from {from}: sums and comparisons are incomplete.
stats_note_face: {name}: its orientation differs from the PV layout.
stats_payback_none: Without an investment there is no payback. Enter it under Settings › Tariff.
stats_payback_done: The investment has paid for itself.
stats_payback_note: Visible to admins only, as it names the investment. Savings are the bill without the plant less the bill with it, each hour at the tariff then in force.
stats_years_chart: {name} {year} by month, last year as a mark
stats_years_fresh_text: Months appear here once they are complete. Comparison with last year starts after twelve months of recording.
stats_forecast_note: The forecast runs the PV layout on the forecast weather and applies the correction each MPPT input learned. A cloud error in the weather forecast is not learned.
stats_tariff_none_text: Savings and costs are priced with the tariff. Enter it under Settings › Tariff.
stats_tariff_note: The bill uses the tariff alone, each hour at the price then in force.
stats_battery_health_text: A measurement is taken when the battery discharges by at least 20 points without a break. From two measurements on, the trend appears here.
stats_data_note: A gap is not a zero: sums leave it out, comparisons across it are marked incomplete, and the chart hatches it.
access_viewers_hint: Viewers see live values and history but change nothing.
access_tokens_hint: For integrations such as evcc. Read sees values and history, admin may do everything.
access_revoke_token_note: Whatever uses {name} loses access at once.
access_once: Copy it now. It will not be shown again.
builder_templates_hint: The closest shape fills the scene, facing south. Sizes and roof can be adjusted afterwards.
stats_capacity_change_wait: needs half a year of measurements
stats_payback_wait: A forecast follows after three months of recording: until then there is no reliable pace.
stats_capacity_note: Estimated from the state of charge: energy discharged over the charge it used. The inverter reports no health value of its own, hence “≈”. The capacity covers the whole record, not just the chosen span.
stats_payback_pace: At the last twelve months' pace ({pace} a year) the investment is paid back in {month}.
stats_capacity_chart: The battery's usable capacity over time
about_car_changed: reduced, without interior, badges and textures
builder_no_module_type_yet: No module type yet. Add the one on the roof; its values are on the datasheet.
settings_device_on_connection_hint: Such as an EVCC loadpoint over MQTT, on a connection that exists or that you create here.
settings_device_profile_fixed: The profile stays fixed for as long as the device exists.
settings_topology_hint: The devices have changed. Do the measuring points still fit?
settings_connection_publish_hint: The plant's values and each device's availability under the topic root.
settings_connection_remove_note: Only a connection no device uses can be removed.
devices_known: SunReye already reads {count} of the devices found.
refused_string_modules: No module belongs to {name} yet. Paint modules into it, then save.
log_empty_hint: Every write lands here, with its outcome.
opening_refused_room: The wall has no room for that.
explore_none_text: Choose a series to see it over time.
explore_catalog_error: The series could not be loaded.
explore_catalog_empty: No series has been recorded yet.
explore_pending: This view's chart is on its way.
explore_full_series: A chart holds 6 series. Remove one to choose another.
explore_full_lanes: A chart holds 4 lanes, one per unit. Series of the units drawn can still be chosen.
explore_left: Not drawn: {names}. A chart holds 6 series in 4 lanes, one per unit.
explore_hourly: Only hourly figures are kept of this day.
explore_expired: States and held values do not reach back that far.
explore_many: Too many changes in this range: {names}. Choose a shorter one.
explore_chart_keys: {chart}. Arrow keys move the pointer, Shift and arrow keys select a span, Enter opens it.
explore_chart_unread: The chart cannot be drawn without the list of series.
